title: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition
notes: MacBook Air M4 16GB, LG ultrawide 2560x1080 external (lid closed), engine x64-crossover26.3-r31, Steam version. Playable with workarounds. Setup that works: - Mode for this game: DXVK. Launch argument: -availablevidmem 4000. - Rockstar Games Launcher installed in a separate environment (Highball option). This fixed "Failed to initialize Rockstar Games Launcher" and the SocialClubHelper crash. - Steam overlay disabled for the game. - In game: 2560x1080 at 50 Hz, VSync on. At 100 Hz VSync gave uneven frame pacing and sluggish movement; 50 Hz is smooth. - Emulate display mode changes off. Issues: - Black line segments flicker on screen with all renderers (Wine Direct3D, DXMT fallback and DXVK). Definition and Shadow settings make no difference. Much reduced at native resolution, worse when scaled (1280x540), but not fully gone. - Changing graphics settings in game sometimes crashes or blacks out the screen. A 16:9 mode (1280x720 at 60 Hz) on the 21:9 monitor gave a black screen that persisted on relaunch until SETTINGS.CFG was deleted. Change one setting at a time and restart. - The macOS cursor stayed visible and active alongside the game cursor (triggered hot corners). Fixed with the registry key HKCU\Software\Wine\Mac Driver\CaptureDisplaysForFullscreen = "y". - With DXVK, startup occasionally hangs (SocialClubHelper D3D11 QueryInterface loop, then Steam "BMainLoop stalled"). Stop and relaunch works.
issues: Black line segments flicker on screen with every renderer, reduced at native resolution but not gone. Changing graphics settings in game can crash or black out the screen (needed SETTINGS.CFG reset once). macOS cursor stayed visible alongside the game cursor until CaptureDisplaysForFullscreen was set in the registry. Occasional startup hang with DXVK; relaunch fixes it. Rockstar launcher only worked after installing it in a separate environment.
